judge_reasoning: Prompt anchor: "Write an essay comparing the cultures of Canada and the United States. Write at least 80 words. Include the following vocabulary: - Square mile - Border - Coastline - Provinces - Language - English - French - Diversity - Married - Children - Education - Art - Cities". Markers N=4: [1] "Canada and the United States, two vast", [2] "Canada and the United States, two nations", [3] "Canada and the United States share the", [4] "The United States and Canada are two". Candidate [1] best matches the requested vocabulary/essay task and stays mostly general without clearly fabricated statistics, while [2] also covers the vocabulary but adds more potentially shaky quantitative generalizations (e.g., household composition, coastline miles). Candidate [4] includes all vocabulary but makes several plausibly inaccurate specifics (e.g., “free tuition” in some provinces) more than [1], and candidate [3] contains multiple highly specific “recent studies” style claims that are very likely unverifiable/incorrect, making it weakest overall. Therefore [1] ranks highest.
